fullWorkflow:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Edit target: the provided presentation slide. Produce one full 16:9 landscape slide, highest native resolution. Keep the same cream faint graph paper, navy medium-weight natural handwritten Traditional Chinese with pen pressure variation, fine navy pen-outline simple icons, colored-pencil light hatching, purple/blue/teal/coral accents, ample whitespace. No page number, badges, watermark or black borders. Change content to convey BOTH retesting the complete workflow AND previously passing other scenarios after modifying Skill, not just a title.
Title verbatim:「改完 Skill，完整流程與其他情境都要重測」
Two balanced groups across middle. Left larger group header「完整流程」: three modest original-style icons arranged in sequence: report/document「交付結果」, connected workflow nodes「執行步驟」, document+wrench「工具與參數」. A subtle rounded blue enclosing frame ties them as one complete task. Right group header「其他情境」: a small stack of test-case checklist sheets, labeled「原本通過的案例」, with green ticks and one coral question mark showing need to retest, not claimed results. Bottom one short handwritten line「不只看原本的問題，也要確認其他情境沒有退步」. Preserve original illustration vocabulary and lettering weight; do not use printed fonts, monoline type, brush calligraphy, robots, 3D, or oversized heavy letters. Content must stay legible at projection size and diagram must explain what is retested.
judge: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: provided slide. Keep full 16:9 cream faint graph paper and original navy pen/colored-pencil handwritten visual language. Preserve title「驗收修改：哪些用程式，哪些用 Judge？」, preserve the entire LEFT half with blue header「明確規則 → 程式」, its Tool call/checklist icons and text「Builder 有呼叫嗎？」「Ref 有效嗎？」「必要欄位齊全嗎？」 as closely as possible. ONLY replace RIGHT half's evidence-source/claim-support content with rubric-based output assessment. Purple header「語意判斷 → Judge」. Small coral caution「Judge 也可能判錯」. Below, two small input documents labeled「輸出內容」and「評分準則／參考範例」 feed via simple arrows to a purple speech bubble labeled「Judge」, then a compact result card「分數／是否達標」. Under this diagram, two readable questions「是否符合需求？」「是否涵蓋重點？」. Remove all「證據來源」and「證據支持結論嗎？」 wording, no evidence provenance verification illustration. Natural medium-weight navy handwritten text, not printed font, not thick brush writing; simple original icons, light pen hatching, generous whitespace. No page numbers/watermarks/borders.
